title: Time-bounded oracle computation
statement: Let $M$ be an oracle Turing machine, let $O$ be an oracle language, and let $x$ and $y$ be input and output words. For a nonnegative integer $t$, $M$ computes $y$ on input $x$ within $t$ steps relative to $O$ if its configuration after exactly $t$ steps has halted and its output tape contains exactly $y$.
